rules.replacementBoundary: Decisions may be attached as optional fingerprinted development evidence; no global ADR number grants authority.
rules.rationale: A repository-wide sequential ADR namespace creates coordination ceremony without proving a decision, its applicability, or its evidence.
Aliases are now closed, normalized Context vocabulary facts. Kernel rejects duplicate or colliding canonical terms and aliases instead of linting arbitrary prose.
The legacy Markdown table is replaced by closed typed vocabulary entries, so malformed alias rows cannot enter the canonical graph.
A governed Context vocabulary must contain at least one typed entry, so a renamed or empty prose section cannot silently disable validation.
Every governed workflow guide is explicitly invocable only; host projection cannot reinterpret a workflow guide as auto-firing effect authority.

rules.replacementBoundary: Deterministic host projection definitions own selected instruction bytes independently for Codex and Claude.
rules.rationale: A Claude-only line count is not a portable correctness rule and cannot prove host comprehension; exact generated bytes and host-specific conformance replace it.

rules.replacementBoundary: Kernel rules live in versioned contracts, verifier code, and planted selftests rather than free-form rule Markdown.
rules.rationale: Line count was an authoring hint, not a behavioral invariant; closed contracts and executable rule tests provide the actual boundary.

rules.replacementBoundary: Workflow guide fields are individually bounded and deterministic host templates control the realized skill structure.
rules.rationale: A whole-file line count depends on host formatting and is replaced by closed bounded fields plus exact projection bytes.

rules.replacementBoundary: Pack ownership, dependencies, source fingerprints, migration evidence, and limitations mechanically establish provenance.
rules.rationale: Citing an ADR number did not prove ownership or behavior and decisions remain optional evidence rather than a mandatory system-birth ceremony.

rules.rationale: Each portable term must resolve to one exact Context pack, version, artifact, authority subject, and semantic model.

A pack cannot declare a definition, implementation, evaluation, or migration artifact that is absent from the repository.

rules.rationale: Vocabulary ownership is validated directly against one Context pack and semantic model; no parallel card registry can drift from it.

rules.replacementBoundary: Typed workflow intent and exact host projection templates own selection facts without person-pronoun token heuristics.
rules.rationale: Pronoun scanning was a warning heuristic and did not mechanically establish routing correctness or behavioral evidence.

rules.replacementBoundary: Each host projection selects an explicit workflow set and realizes exact bounded guide fields under its own definition.
rules.rationale: One global Claude startup-character estimate is not portable across hosts or versions and cannot serve as a correctness claim.

rules.replacementBoundary: Workflow goal, useWhen, excludeWhen, safeguards, procedure, and effect boundary are required typed facts.
rules.rationale: A leading-verb warning was subjective authoring advice; required intent and boundary fields are inspectable and versioned.

rules.replacementBoundary: Host templates serialize bounded canonical strings deterministically and do not accept arbitrary generated markup authority.
rules.rationale: The blanket angle-tag heuristic was tied to one host skill convention and is not a provider-neutral domain or authority invariant.
Active host-guided workflows require at least three exact cases including happy-path, pressure, and invariant coverage.
Every workflow definition must carry at least one typed exclusion, independent of wording variants in prose.

rules.replacementBoundary: Exact pack selection, workflow ownership, typed use and exclude boundaries, and explicit user configuration govern routing.
rules.rationale: Token overlap produced advisory false positives and could not decide semantic ownership; v2 requires explicit ownership without claiming automated semantic disjointness.

rules.rationale: Connected target knowledge is current only for an exact lock, provider observation, call state, and evidence applicability; prose date stamps grant no readiness.

rules.rationale: Blanket date and phrase matching conflated durable prose with provenance; typed temporal facts now fail closed in the authority objects that use them.

rules.replacementBoundary: Every v2 workflow guide is explicit-only and therefore has no auto-trigger claim to test.

limitations: This transition map proves complete disposition of the frozen 47-code checker vocabulary; it does not by itself prove that every legacy source behavior has completed migration evidence.
Intentional retirement is a scoped behavior change, not parity, and cannot promote readiness, connected verification, health, host support, or provider behavior.
The legacy checker may be removed only after its inventory bindings have exact migration evidence, target authority or explicit retirement, removed fallback, and no host or configuration dependency.
